full_analysis:
## Market Structure & Technical Context

AUDJPY has formed a textbook Double Top pattern on the H4 timeframe, testing the key resistance ceiling at 106.18. The Elliott Wave engine identifies a Wave 5 in progress within an Intermediate degree bearish impulse, validating the short entry at 105.58. This technical convergence targets a move down to 103.67, offering an attractive 1:2.8 risk-to-reward ratio over the swing horizon.

The momentum profile displays an RSI reading of 48.6, reflecting neutral-bearish conditions, while the EMA20 (105.51) resides below the EMA50 (106.27), confirming the prevailing downward trend momentum. The H4 ATR of 0.51 supports a tight 1.3x ATR risk buffer.

## Key Levels

- **Resistance**: 106.28 (Algo Stop Loss level encompassing the pattern peaks)
- **Support**: 103.67 (Algo Take Profit target below structural lows)

## Invalidation Level

A 4H candle close above 106.28 invalidates the Double Top pattern and confirms bullish resumption.

## Macro Context

Ongoing trade friction and shifting risk sentiment heavily impact high-beta commodity currencies like the Australian Dollar against safe-haven flows.
